title: The Last Postcard
author: Astrid Villalobos
blurb: Edmund Okonkwo, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
